games.desc:
A Difficult RPG based on the World of the Project Moon Game Series.

May you find your Book in this place.

Controls Are Listed Below:

Movement – ( WASD )

Dash – ( Q )

Jump – ( Space )

Equip / Unequip Weapon – ( E )

Attack – ( LMB )

Block – ( F )

Parry – ( RMB )

Critical / Heavy Attack – ( R )

Charged Attack – ( LCtrl (Hold) + M1 )

Aiming – ( LCtrl (Hold) + M2 )

Execute Knocked Opponent - ( B )

Carry Knocked Opponent - ( V )

Ragdoll Cancel – ( Space w/ Ragdoll )

Skip Dialogue - ( V ) (While in Dialogue)
